subject: Redwood / NebulaCloud A/B latency + throughput lab — scope & timeline
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ian Mercer <ian.mercer@skyrun.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood / NebulaCloud A/B latency + throughput lab — scope & timeline

Hi Ian / Skyrun performance team — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end so we can kick off the hands-on comparison next week. TL;DR: we propose a focused A/B lab to compare p95/p99 latency and sustained tokens/sec for your representative prompt mix (chat + instruction completion).

Background from call:
- Goal: validate whether NebulaCloud's hosted inference adds visible tail latency under your peak patterns vs Redwood running same model family and config.
- Top metrics you asked us to measure: p95, p99, 99.9th (if possible), tokens/sec steady state, and throughput (concurrent requests/sec).
- Test workload: 60/40 split chat:single-turn, with seq length distribution you shared (median 128, 95th 1024).

Proposed lab scope (attachment: redwood-nebula-ab-plan-v1.xlsx):
1) Baseline configs (two arms):
   - Redwood arm: redwood-opt-1.3b (int8/quantized) on our standard inference profile (continuous batching enabled, KV prefix cache).
   - Nebula arm: NebulaCloud hosted endpoint (their recommended production config).
2) Test harness and load pattern:
   - Ramp to target concurrency over 10 minutes, hold for 45 minutes (steady-state window = last 30 minutes).
   - Two concurrency targets: nominal (50% traffic) and peak (100% expected peak).
3) Measurement windows & metrics:
   - p50/p95/p99/p99.9 for request latency (ms), tokens/sec, tokens/op, and aggregate throughput.
   - Record server-side queueing and batch sizes if available.
4) Inputs & dataset:
   - You will provide 500 production-like prompts (anonymized). We will run 3 repeats per arm.
5) Security & access:
   - We request short-lived test API keys for Nebula and authorization to run the harness from your test VPC (or whitelisted IPs).

Deliverables & timeline:
- Draft plan and config (this email + attached spreadsheet) — today.
- Lab run 1 (nominal): target window Tue 2027-09-21 10:00–12:00 PST.
- Lab run 2 (peak): Wed 2027-09-22 10:00–12:00 PST.
- Results deck and raw CSVs within 48 hours after runs.

Open asks from Skyrun:
- Confirm the prompt set by Mon 2027-09-20 EOD.
- Provide NebulaCloud test endpoint + access details by Mon 2027-09-20.

Marissa / Aditya — can you confirm infra readiness (GPU profile / batch settings) and whether we need any custom tracing to capture server-side batch sizes? I attached a sample measurement yaml with metric names we’ll publish.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- We'll confirm the anonymized prompt set by Mon (should be fine).
- NebulaCloud will give us a short-lived test token; I can share it once we lock the run window.

If you can confirm those two items and lock the Tue/Wed windows, I'll put calendar holds and loop Sandra for the compliance note.

Rafael — quick internal notes / checklist before we confirm windows to Skyrun:

1) Infra profile: we'll run redwood-opt-1.3b on a 4-GPU pod (A100-equivalent) with continuous batching enabled. Default batch cap = 32, but for peak runs we'll cap at 64 and record effective batch sizes.
2) Measurement details: we will publish both per-worker tokens/sec and cluster-aggregated tokens/sec (will compute by summing per-worker counters). p99 will be calculated on end-to-end latency including queueing.
3) Tracing: I recommend enabling lightweight tracing (request ID + batch size + worker ID) — we can add that flag to the harness.
4) Logs & artifacts: we will produce CSVs per run and a summary deck. I attached an initial measurement yaml (latency-measurement-config.yaml) with metric names and sink locations.

Operational ask: Aditya, please confirm that ops can spin the 4-GPU pod for 48 hours starting Tue 09/21 and that we have monitoring set to capture histograms at 1s resolution.

If all good, Rafael please confirm back to Ian and loop Sandra for compliance signoff.

Marissa
